note: Hand classes kept from the 2026-10-22 analysis (tantivy9) where still valid; classes of bugs fixed since (cross-line enumerators, fuzzy swap, unterminated <) removed. Rows whose only difference is the footnote notes books are classified automatically by hitcount.py. Re-check after any engine change.
method: Every query Otzaria ran (`otz_report.py`: one word = exact, several words = advanced with the TAB distance or 1000, `w~k` = fuzzy), against ours on the positions index (current format) with Otzaria-mode options: one word plain; several words `proximity: ordered, gaps = distance` and `cross_line: true` (Otzaria's advanced mode is ordered and crosses one line break); fuzzy with `ignore_quotes: true` (Otzaria's quote is transparent). Hits = matching lines. Each difference was diffed line by line in the 2026-10-22 analysis (Otzaria v5.0.0, tantivy9); since 2026-11-13 the comparison runs against Otzaria 5babbce and also counts ours over real books only (footnote notes books excluded).
notes: (2026-10-22, v5.0.0) Footnote markers (most rows, ours +0.02..0.1%): Otzaria removes inline tags with no separator (`strip_html_for_indexing`; `sup` is inline), so `word<sup>5</sup>` indexes as one token `word5` and the word is lost; ours ends a word at `<sup>`/`<sub>` (FtsLib's scanner rule). Every ours-only line of the exact rows has a `<sup>` (checked all; samples 8576169, 7692606, 2451902).
(2026-10-22, v5.0.0) Bare `&` (Otzaria bug): line 3760145 `Shiur & made ... pocket;` - Otzaria's entity rule `&[^;]+;` deletes everything up to the next `;`.
(2026-10-22, v5.0.0) Without `cross_line` our multi-word counts are lower by up to 39% (e.g. words q4: 87,256 vs 143,836): Otzaria's advanced mode always crosses one line break.
Fixed since 2026-10-22 (rows re-checked by the 2026-11-13 run, classes removed): cross-line enumerators (tantivy10 content edges), unterminated `<`, fuzzy swap = one edit (transposition).

Footnotes (2026-11-13): ours indexes each schema-7 note as a line of a virtual notes book (issue #13). Otzaria 5babbce indexes footnotes too (its index grew 1,988 to 2,182 MB with the same 7,643,689 line documents), so the notes are not a clean explanation: ours over real books only is BELOW Otzaria on most rows, ours with notes slightly above. Most rows stay unclassified until a line-level diff against 5babbce.
rules q19: intentional (user decision 2026-11-15): a query word of 128 bytes or more is dropped from the query (its position kept); Otzaria's advanced mode keeps it as a required word and returns 0.

words:6: footnote marker: Otzaria glues `<sup>` to the word (word5), ours ends the word at `<sup>` (FtsLib rule) (marker digits on the next line become our cross-line hits)
words:7: footnote marker: Otzaria glues `<sup>` to the word (word5), ours ends the word at `<sup>` (FtsLib rule) (marker digits on the next line become our cross-line hits)
words:11: footnote marker: Otzaria glues `<sup>` to the word (word5), ours ends the word at `<sup>` (FtsLib rule) (not line-checked: 4.8M hits; magnitude as the other sup rows)
rules:5: Otzaria strips a bare `&` through the next `;` (entity rule), deleting the words between
rules:17: paired reading (X) [Y] is one typed word: equal (229) once sent without a gap list
rules:19: intentional, documented difference (user decision 2026-11-15): a query word of 128 bytes or more is unindexable; ours drops it from the query and keeps its position, Otzaria keeps it as a required word and finds nothing
large:54: quote word, fuzzy ~1: Otzaria 5babbce keeps the gershayim in the term and counts it as a character in the fuzzy automaton (plus the exact quote-free spelling only); hitcount sends ours with ignore_quotes (FtsLib behaviour), which runs the fuzzy on the quote-free form, so every quote-free word within 1 edit of the stem matches too
